description.value:
Prerequisite(s): 1 level in Turk prestige class or 5 ranks in Sense Motive, Wis 15

Benefit: When entering this style, you can perform an Assessment. As a standard action, you can perform a Sense Motive check against a creature within 30 feet. On a successful check, you learn the creature's preferred method of attack and gain a +2 insight bonus to AC, Reflex Saves, or Wisdom/Intelligence checks against the creature.
